candidates.claim: The `elems` array is built eagerly even when `selectorOrHaystack` is an object or node, causing unnecessary performance overhead.
candidates.suggested_fix: Move the `if (selectorOrHaystack && typeof selectorOrHaystack !== 'string')` check to the very beginning of the function, before computing `elems`.
